### Hazards Discovered

**Known hazards for future sprints:**
- Treat a required store schema migration as a major release even when conventional commit analysis recommends a minor.
- A migration doctor must inspect metadata without constructing the normal store because normal store construction applies migrations.
- Release documentation must distinguish automatic upgrade from restore-based downgrade; 1.x writers cannot safely coexist after migration.

### Training Log

| Type | Description | Outcome |

| Lessons | Release-tier heuristics cannot infer every breaking operational contract from commit prefixes. | The checked-in release policy and issue contract override the minor heuristic and require 2.0.0 for the store migration. |
